sahneler.metin: On final approach to Heathrow, both engines of a Boeing 777 lost power.
Suddenly it dropped short and slammed onto the grass before the runway.
The tanks had plenty of fuel.
On the long cold flight, ice had formed in the fuel.
When thrust increased, it built up at the heat exchangers.
The engines were starved of fuel.

aciklama:
British Airways 38 lost thrust on both engines on final approach. The cause: ice crystals from the fuel accumulating and blocking the fuel-oil heat exchanger inlets.
